title: Air Alert: alerts and target movement
note: Official alerts and approximate movement of cruise missiles and Shahed drones from the Air Force. Does not show ballistic missiles; data is delayed.

title: monitor: drone map
note: Approximate drone positions based on posts by regional monitoring channels, updated every 20 seconds. Not an official alert.

title: KyivSafety: risk by address in Kyiv
note: A 0–100 score for an address based on past strikes and overflights from open sources; a research tool. Low risk on the map is not safety: an alert means shelter.

title: alerts.in.ua
note: Map of alerts by region and community, from official channels.

title: DeepState: front line
note: Front line and occupied territories from open sources, delayed by a few days; run by a volunteer team. Use only this address: clones exist.

title: ISW: analytical maps
note: Daily maps and reports from a US think tank, in English.

title: 112 Ukraine (Ministry of Internal Affairs)
note: Call 112 over the internet when there is no mobile signal. Sign in in advance via ID.GOV.UA.

title: Evacuation line 1548
note: 24/7 government hotline for crisis issues, including evacuation.

title: Diia: shelters and Invincibility Points
note: The Diia government app has a map of shelters and Invincibility Points.

title: State Emergency Service (DSNS): mine hazard map
note: Areas where there may be mines and explosive objects.

title: Vostok SOS: evacuation
note: Evacuate children, seriously ill and people with limited mobility; help with accommodation. Mon–Sat, 8:00–18:00.

title: Angels of Salvation: evacuation
note: Evacuation with medical escort and, if needed, accommodation.

title: Helping to Leave
note: Help people leave occupied territories; publish annual reports.

title: UNHCR: guide for Ukrainians
note: Help for displaced people, contacts, rights.

title: UAnimals: animals
note: Evacuation of animals from frontline areas. Applications are sometimes paused, so check the website.

title: Coordination HQ for Prisoners of War
note: Report a captured person and track the case; hotline 0 800 300 529. Scammers ask for money “for information”. Do not pay.

title: Register of missing persons (Ministry of Internal Affairs)
note: Add a person to the register and get an extract; line 1698.

title: National Information Bureau
note: Search for civilians and military personnel missing because of the war.

title: Red Cross: finding relatives
note: Tracing relatives and restoring contact, free of charge; line 0 800 300 155.

title: “How are you?” (Ty yak?)
note: Government mental health programme: exercises, courses and where to get help.

title: La Strada: 116 123
note: 24/7 and free: violence, human trafficking. For children and young people: 116 111.

title: Government line 1547
note: 24/7: domestic violence, human trafficking, violence against children.

title: Teenergizer
note: Free psychologist consultations for teenagers and young people.

title: Free legal aid
note: Free consultation with a lawyer, including for those affected by the war; 0 800 213 103.

title: Report a war crime
note: Office of the Prosecutor General: describe a crime and submit evidence.

title: Ukrainian Helsinki Human Rights Union
note: Legal help for those affected by the war, including with the Register of Damage.

title: ZMINA Human Rights Centre
note: Human rights organisation: documents war crimes and human rights violations.

title: LUN Misto: shelter reviews
note: Residents report whether a shelter is open. Not official: inspections found listed shelters that don’t actually exist.

title: Pension Fund: support for IDPs
note: Living allowance for internally displaced people and compensation for those hosting them; hotline 0 800 503 753.

title: Housing vouchers (Diia)
note: Housing voucher for displaced people from occupied territories. Apply only in Diia; the queue is free.

title: eOselia
note: State subsidised mortgage programme; terms and rates on the website.

title: State Employment Service
note: Job search, training, grants to start your own business.

title: Government hotline 1545
note: Questions and complaints to any government body, including about payments.

title: Right to Protection: lawyers for IDPs
note: Free consultations on forced displacement and protecting your rights. Hotline 093 507 50 90, Mon–Fri 8:00–21:00.

title: eRecovery (Diia)
note: Money for repairs, or new housing in place of destroyed housing. Apply only in Diia, free of charge.

title: UNICEF “Spilno”
note: Cash assistance for families with children; 0 800 600 017. UNICEF never asks for a CVV, password or “fee”.

title: Cyber Police: scammers
note: Gave card details to scammers? First block the card with your bank, then report; 0 800 505 170.

title: State Migration Service: passport and documents
note: Lost your passport? Report to the police, then go to the Migration Service, a TSNAP or “Dokument” centre. Meanwhile, use Diia.

title: Ministry of Justice: births and deaths in occupied areas
note: First a court establishes the fact, then the civil registry (DRATS) issues a Ukrainian certificate.

title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: consulates and e-Consul
note: Documents for people abroad: apply online, collect at the consulate.

title: Children of War
note: Report a deported or missing child. Do not pay anyone to “find” a child.

title: Bring Kids Back UA
note: Government initiative to return children taken by Russia.

title: Children’s line 116 111
note: Anonymous and free: bullying, violence, conflicts. Also 0 800 500 225.

title: Voices of Children: psychological help
note: Free psychological support for children and parents who lived through the war; centres in several cities. Line 0 800 210 106.

title: Single veterans’ line 1528
note: Status, benefits, housing, jobs, psychological help; daily 8–20, free of charge.

title: Veteran PRO: support specialist
note: A personal support specialist in your community helps make a plan and arrange services.

title: Ukrainian Veterans Fund: crisis line
note: 24/7 psychological and legal support for veterans and families. Waiting times can be long.

title: Veteran Hub
note: Psychological and legal consultations for veterans and families.

title: Pryncyp: legal navigator for the military
note: Step-by-step guidance on rights during service, injury and discharge; a human rights centre for service members and veterans.

title: Legal Hundred (Yurydychna sotnia)
note: Free legal aid for service members, veterans, released POWs and families. Hotline 0 800 308 100.

title: National Health Service (NSZU) 16-77: free healthcare
note: Free services, pharmacies in the “Affordable Medicines” programme, complaints about refusals; psychiatrist without referral.

title: Superhumans
note: Prosthetics and rehabilitation for military and civilians, adults and children; free of charge.

title: Unbroken (Lviv)
note: Municipal centre: rehabilitation, reconstructive surgery, children’s department.

title: Ministry of Health: treatment abroad
note: Your medical facility arranges the referral; intermediary “agencies” are not needed.

title: Pension Fund: contact centre
note: Pensions and social benefits. The Pension Fund never asks for card details by phone.

title: Ombudsman 1678
note: Complaints about rights violations, including in care homes for the elderly.

title: Accessibility map
note: Whether a building is accessible for wheelchairs, prams and people with visual impairments.

title: Proliska: evacuation of people with limited mobility
note: Evacuation of people with disabilities, elderly and bedridden people in special vehicles with medics.

title: Ukrainian Red Cross: first aid courses
note: First aid training for anyone in many cities; certificate. Check price and schedule on the website.

title: Vinnytsia region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: 48-hour basic course, 14 topics, for anyone 18+ with no prior training; free, certificate after passing a test.

title: Volyn region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: 48-hour basic or 108-hour full course, free, for anyone 18+, groups of 20–25 people.

title: Dnipropetrovsk region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: 48- or 100-hour course on the Ministry of Defence programme, free, for residents aged 18–60. Sign up by phone.

title: Zhytomyr region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: tactics, tactical medicine, mine safety, drones, firearms training. Check duration and terms.

title: Zakarpattia region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: 3-month programme, free, for anyone 18+ with no upper age limit; certificate.

title: Ivano-Frankivsk region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: 48-hour course. Check terms and schedule.

title: Kyiv region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: free 110-hour basic course over 7 weeks, mostly at weekends, 16 subject areas.

title: Kyiv city: national resistance training centre
note: City centre: free all year (one-day sessions, 48-hour basic course, 108-hour advanced course).

title: Lviv region: “Defence of Lviv Region” centre
note: Regional national resistance training centre: training in communities across the region. Check duration and terms.

title: Odesa region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: free 48-hour basic course (about 6 weeks, 14 subject areas) for citizens 18+.

title: Poltava region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: free 48-hour course for adults, certificate after training.

title: Kharkiv region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: general military courses of 48 or 108 hours for civilians aged 18–60, free, usually every Saturday.

title: Khmelnytskyi region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: 7 weeks of basic training (tactics, medicine, map reading, communications). Classes are free.

title: Cherkasy region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: all classes free. 2–4 hour modules, short 48-hour or full 108-hour programme.

title: Chernihiv region: national resistance training centre
note: Regional centre: free training with a certificate for residents of the region.

title: Prytula Foundation: Civilian Readiness Centre
note: Trainings for civilians in various cities: pre-medical first aid and other skills. Participation for a donation.

title: Solomianski Kotyky: MEDCAT
note: Training centre of a charity foundation in Kyiv: tactical medicine for civilians.

title: Hospitallers: tactical medicine
note: Volunteer medical battalion trains civilians in tactical medicine in Kyiv, Lviv, Dnipro, Pavlohrad.

title: Ukrainian Resuscitation Council: courses
note: Resuscitation and first aid courses following international guidelines; for civilians and medics.

title: Prometheus: first aid in wartime
note: Free online course to get started; reinforce the skill with in-person training.

title: Defence Forces: vacancies (army.gov.ua)
note: Official vacancy portal: choose a unit and position, leave your number for a recruiter.

title: ArmyInform: vacancy database
note: Single database of Defence Forces vacancies from the Ministry of Defence news agency.

title: Ministry of Defence hotline 1512
note: Questions about service and recruitment; also if your rights have been violated.

title: Ministry of Defence: air defence in volunteer community units
note: How to join air defence groups in volunteer territorial units (DFTG): contact the local unit commander or military administration.

title: UNITED24: government fundraising platform
note: The largest donation platform: defence, demining, medicine, reconstruction. Donate only via the official website.

title: Come Back Alive
note: Foundation for competent help to the army, since 2014, publishes reports. Fake copies exist: use only the official website.

title: Serhiy Prytula Charity Foundation
note: Help for the army and civilians, public reporting. Donate only via the official website.

title: Sternenko Community
note: Charity foundation: FPV and interceptor drones for the troops, monthly reports on every purchase. Donate only via the official website.

title: Military bonds in Diia
note: Ministry of Finance domestic bonds: lend the state money for defence and get it back with interest. No fee in Diia; also via banks.

title: Donor platform: give blood
note: Transplant Coordination Centre: who can donate, where to give blood and which blood types are short in your region.

title: SBU (Security Service) 1516: report something suspicious
note: Planned arson or sabotage, offers to “earn extra”, suspicious people and objects. Free; the old number 0 800 501 482 also works.

title: “How are you?” (Ty yak?): mental health
note: National mental health programme: how to support yourself and loved ones and where to find help.

title: CoMaps
note: Offline street maps, routes and search. Community non-profit project, a fork of Organic Maps; no ads or tracking.

title: Organic Maps
note: Offline street maps and routes. Has affiliate links for hotel booking. Over disputes on project governance, some developers created CoMaps.

title: OsmAnd
note: Most features: offline maps, terrain, trails, routes. Some features are paid.

title: Register of volunteers (Tax Service)
note: Apply to join the register via the Electronic Cabinet with a qualified e-signature (KEP) or on paper using form 1-RV.

title: Ministry of Social Policy e-cabinet
note: Apply for social services, including care, online (without visiting the social protection office).

title: Pension Fund portal
note: Apply for a pension, housing subsidy and certificates online; an electronic signature is required.

title: Diia.Education: digital skills for older people
note: Free video lessons: messengers, search, booking a doctor, paying bills, email.

title: UNICEF: support for parents and children
note: How to help a child during war: breathing exercises, support after difficult events, mine safety.

title: Kiwix: Wikipedia offline
note: Open app from a Swiss non-profit association. Download Ukrainian Wikipedia via Wi‑Fi in advance: full is gigabytes, without images 4x smaller.

title: Army+: app for service members
note: Ministry of Defence: electronic reports, military registration document, certificates, transfers, training courses.

title: Service member’s rights violated: where to turn
note: Ministry of Justice explainer: phone numbers of the General Staff, Ministry of Defence, State Bureau of Investigation and free legal aid.

title: Service member’s power of attorney and will without a notary
note: Ministry of Justice: what a unit commander can certify and under which conditions.

title: Brave1: grants for defence developers
note: Defence technology cluster: non-repayable grants, testing and feedback from the military. You keep the rights to your development.

title: Ministry of Defence Digital Team: IT jobs in the military
note: Over 2000 vacancies for IT specialists in the Defence Forces; apply on the website.

title: Diia.Education: cyber hygiene
note: Free short courses and simulators: phishing, scammers, safety in wartime. For adults, teenagers and parents.

title: Diia.Education: cybersecurity analyst
note: Free online series with Cisco Talos for beginners: how to start in the profession.

title: Cisco Networking Academy
note: Free online courses, some in Ukrainian: intro to cybersecurity, networking, Python. Self-paced.

title: Training voucher for IT and cybersecurity
note: Under certain conditions the Employment Service pays for licensed programmes: for people 45+, IDPs, veterans, disabled, war-affected. Line 1518.

title: SET University: cyber defence with grants
note: Private university: master’s in cyber defence, full and partial grants for military, veterans, families, women.

title: EPAM Campus
note: Free beginner courses from an IT company, with a separate “IT for Veterans” programme. English is often required.

title: Prometheus
note: Ukrainian platform: many free online courses, including university courses in IT and cybersecurity.

title: Svarog Battalion: course for civilians (Kyiv)
note: Free 3-day course by an Unmanned Systems Forces unit with Dronarium Academy: reconnaissance drones and FPV. Periodic intakes.

title: Victory Drones: online courses
note: Free courses by the Dignitas charity foundation: how an FPV drone works and is assembled. For everyone, online.

title: Prometheus: “UAV Engineer”
note: Free online course by Victory Drones on the design and repair of drones.

title: Kill House Academy
note: Drone operator school of the 3rd Army Corps; accepts civilians, including women. Kyiv, Lviv, Odesa, Cherkasy, mobile school.

title: Dronarium Academy
note: Private certified school: FPV, multicopters, agricultural drones. Kyiv and Lviv. Paid for civilians, free for military.

title: Kruk training centre
note: Non-state certified centre: courses for civilians, including fixed-wing drones. Terms and prices on the website.

title: UA Drone School (Brovary)
note: NGO: drone operator courses, paid for civilians.

title: Contract 18–24: drone operator
note: Contract service for young people with training as a drone operator. Terms and age on the official website.

title: Red Cross: regional training centres
note: Where to ask about first aid and instructor training in your region.

title: WHO: psychological first aid
note: World Health Organization guide: how to be there for and support someone after a hard experience.

title: Invincibility Points
note: Heat, light, connectivity and water during outages; the map of points is also in Diia.

title: Ministry of Education: learning during alerts
note: Guidelines: learning in a shelter, the two-hour rule, how to switch between formats.

title: Ministry of Education and DSNS: mine safety lessons
note: Lesson materials on mine safety for schoolchildren.

title: National Research Foundation of Ukraine
note: Open calls for research projects; terms of each on the foundation’s website.

title: Ukraine in Horizon Europe
note: European Commission: Ukrainian researchers take part in the programme on equal terms with EU institutions.

title: MSCA4Ukraine: fellowships for researchers
note: European Commission fellowships for scholars forced to leave Ukraine; the page shows the 2025 call, new ones when announced.

title: Electronic reservation of employees in Diia
note: Ministry of Defence (2024): how a critical enterprise reserves employees from mobilisation; the rules have changed since.

title: Safe working conditions for energy workers
note: Ministry of Energy: draft new safety rules, including for emergency repair work.

title: State Agrarian Register
note: Applications for demining farmland and for agricultural programmes.

title: Diia.Business
note: Free consultations for entrepreneurs, regional centres, grants.

title: NADS (civil service agency): training for officials
note: Professional development for civil servants and local government officials.

title: Decentralization: resources for communities
note: Materials and training for communities and local authorities.

title: Ukrainian Cultural Foundation
note: Grants and scholarships for artists and cultural projects; calls every year.

title: NUJU: journalist solidarity centres
note: Help for media workers: housing in a new place, a workspace, protective gear, first aid kits.

title: Institute of Mass Information
note: Monitors freedom of speech and records crimes against the media.

title: Ministry of Education: admission and study
note: University admission, state study grants, student rights.

title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: consulate e-queue
note: Book a consular service online; sign in via ID.GOV.UA (KEP, Diia.Signature, BankID).

title: Ministry of Social Policy: support abroad
note: Unity centres, the “Dodomu” (Home) platform for those planning to return.

title: Ministry of Education: Ukrainian school from anywhere
note: Ways for children abroad to study in a Ukrainian school.

title: eMalyatko (eBaby) in Diia
note: Birth registration and up to nine services in one application: in Diia, at a TSNAP, civil registry or maternity hospital.

title: Road Traffic Rules
note: Current text of Cabinet of Ministers resolution No. 1306 on the Verkhovna Rada (parliament) website.

title: Driving theory questions and exam
note: Main Service Centre of the Interior Ministry: official exam questions and answers, free and without registration.

title: How to get your first driving licence
note: Main Service Centre of the Interior Ministry: steps from the medical certificate to the practical exam.

title: List of accredited driving schools
note: Main Service Centre of the Interior Ministry: driving schools by region with certificate numbers.

title: Book an exam at an Interior Ministry service centre
note: Electronic queue: choose a service centre, date and time.

title: Diia: exchanging a driving licence
note: How to exchange or restore a licence online; a first licence is not issued online.

title: Plast (National Scout Organization of Ukraine)
note: Scout groups for children from age 6, teens and youth: camps, outdoor skills, first aid, community service. Branches in Ukraine and abroad.

title: Center for Countering Disinformation
note: Debunks fakes and warns about hostile channels and bots.

title: VoxCheck
note: Fact-checking of statements and fakes by VoxUkraine.

title: StopFake
note: Debunking Russian fakes since 2014.

title: Detector Media: disinformation
note: Analysis of propaganda and fakes, including about air alerts.
